text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The unsettled feeling Mihono Bourbon has been experiencing doesn't abate. Her condition and lap times deteriorate, and it all comes to a head when she collapses.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While recovering, she comes across Rice Shower undergoing intense training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower says that she wants to defeat Mihono Bourbon, whom she looks up to. Her determination to win pushes her to change and become stronger.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mihono Bourbon, who harbors the same emotions, realizes that the true nature of the unsettled feeling she's been experiencing is actually her "desire to win."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After this revelation, she recovers in the blink of an eye.
